```csharp title="C#"

using HtmlToMarkdown;

var result = HtmlToMarkdownConverter.Convert("<nav>NavSection</nav><p>Paragraph</p>", new ConversionOptions { Preprocessing = new PreprocessingOptions { Enabled = false } });
Console.WriteLine(result);
```
